displayName: Instacart API - Grocery Prices by Store and ZIP, Price Compare
description: Instacart API for Instacart (instacart.com, the US and Canada grocery delivery and pickup marketplace) - Instacart prices by store at a ZIP, one product priced across the stores delivering to a US ZIP or Canadian postal code (the same product id at 153 stores at ZIP 10001, low to high, with the sale price, the regular price and Instacart's No markups flag), every store serving a ZIP with its delivery and pickup ETA, No markups and EBT labels; search one store with prices, sale price and regular price, unit price, loyalty price, multi-buy offers, stock label and dietary labels, sorted by price, filtered to sale items or a brand and paged through every match, priced for delivery, pickup or Instacart's in-store prices, so a delivery price can sit next to the same store's in-store price; every price carries priced_for with the retailer's pricing label as Instacart shows it; one query priced across up to 10 stores at a US ZIP; one product at one store with ingredients, allergen warnings, key nutrients and the rating summary; the department and aisle tree, an aisle or collection, the store's Sales collection, pickup locations with 7 days of hours, search suggestions and US customer reviews (15 a page, source and incentivized flag, no reviewer names). Canada (instacart.ca, CAD) in English or French. 11 endpoints, 1 credit per call, search 3, cross-search 3-4. No delivery or service fee amounts, order minimums, coupons, Instacart+ prices, price history or checkout.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
